formula.label: Formula
formula.hint: MONO works this out by itself. Nobody types it.
formula.fields: Fields you can use (tap to add)
formula.known: From the start form and the steps before
formula.noFields: Add number, amount, date or item-line fields to this form first.

gives.datetime: It gives a date and time.

formula.exampleNone: no value (something it needs is empty)

help.title: How to write a formula
help.intro: Use the names of the fields, numbers and these signs. Spaces don't matter.
help.math: + add · − take away · × multiply · ÷ divide · ( ) do this part first
help.percent: amount × 18% is 18% of the amount. amount + 18% adds 18% to it; amount − 10% takes 10% off.
help.dates: checkout − checkin is the number of nights. date + 2 is two days later.
help.blank: If a field it needs is empty, the formula stays empty — it does not count it as 0.
help.round: Numbers are kept to 2 decimal places unless you use round.

fn.round: round(amount, 0) — round to so many decimal places (0 = whole number)
fn.min: min(a, b) — the smallest (or the earliest date)
fn.max: max(a, b) — the largest (or the latest date)
fn.days: days(checkout, checkin) — nights between two dates
fn.hours: hours(end, start) — hours between two dates with time
fn.sum: sum(items) — total amount of the item lines; sum(items, 'qty') adds the quantities; sum(a, b, c) adds numbers
fn.if: if(qty > 10, 5, 0) — one value when the question is true, the other when it is not. Questions use < > <= >= = !=
fn.ifblank: ifblank(discount, 0) — use 0 when the field is empty

p.empty: Write the formula, for example: qty × rate
p.tooLong: This formula is too long (500 characters at most). Split it into two formula fields.
p.tooDeep: Too many brackets inside each other. Split the formula into two formula fields.
p.badChar: A formula can't use "{{name}}". Use field names, numbers and + − × ÷ % ( ).
p.badNumber: "{{name}}" is not a number. Write it like 1200 or 12.5, without commas.
p.openText: The text in quotes is never closed. Add the closing quote.
p.missingBetween: Something is missing between "{{name}}" and "{{other}}". Put + − × or ÷ there.
p.openBracket: This bracket is never closed. Add a ) at the end.
p.emptyBrackets: There is nothing inside these brackets.
p.comma: A comma only goes between the values of a function, like min(a, b). Write decimals with a point: 12.5
p.unknownFunction: There is no function called "{{name}}". You can use: round, min, max, days, hours, sum, count, if, ifblank.
p.sumColumn: sum can add up 'amount', 'qty' or 'rate' of the item lines, not "{{name}}".
p.unknownField: There is no field called "{{name}}" here. Pick a field from the list.
p.needsBrackets: "{{name}}" is a function. Write it like this: {{other}}
p.self: A formula can't use its own field ("{{name}}").
p.cycle: This formula uses "{{name}}", and "{{name}}" uses this field back. One of them has to change.
p.fieldType: "{{name}}" can't be used in a formula. Use number, amount, date, yes/no, choice or item-line fields.
p.itemsOutside: Item lines can only be used inside sum( ) or count( ), like sum({{name}}).
p.needsItems: {{name}}( ) needs a field with item lines.
p.needsNumber: "{{name}}" is not a number, so it can't be used in a sum.
p.dateMath: Dates can't be used like this. You can add or take away days (date + 2) or take one date from another (to − from).
p.condition: if( ) starts with a question, like this: if(a > b, x, y)
p.compare: This compares two things, which gives yes or no. Put it inside if( ), like this: if(a > b, x, y)
p.textCompare: Text and yes/no can only be checked with = or ≠.
p.sameKind: "{{name}}" and "{{other}}" are different kinds of value (number, date, text), so they can't go together here.
p.result: A formula must give a number or a date. This one gives text or yes/no.
